items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer lists Teddy Wilson as one of the artists the interviewee recorded for, but the interviewee does not respond to confirm this or describe a personal/professional interaction.

ctx.x: Who else did you record for during that period?
Oh, brother, let's see. Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw, Coleman Hawkins, Teddy Wilson, the All-Star Band?
